scope: Prespecified finite-panel functional-evidence analysis; not a confirmatory assay-population inference or a trained prediction model
question: Do published PRKDC-partner adverse genetic-interaction hypotheses show concordant AZD7648-conditioned sensitization in the two parental-A549 experiments, and is their prioritization distinguishable from generic genetic fragility, untreated fitness, and the available R2 DDR-drug sensitivity controls?
primary_panel: Exactly the 380 complete-endpoint partner genes with identical published R2 transcript labels across DNAPKi rho, its matched gamma, ATMi rho, ATRi rho and WEE1i rho
identity_policy: Exact published gene symbols only; source IDs, row IDs, transcript labels and element IDs retained; no alias repair

r3_gene_summary.unit: distinct original scored element records within a published gene symbol
r3_gene_summary.eligibility: both WT rho and its matched parent gamma finite in the SAME record
r3_gene_summary.central_summary: unweighted median across eligible records, separately for rho and gamma; descriptive gene-label summaries, not a synthetic single construct or replicate estimate
r3_gene_summary.envelope: For pairwise separation, least-sensitive source-called versus most-sensitive comparator is the lower observed-record bound; reverse choices give the upper bound. These are NOT confidence intervals.

rank_formula: (midrank(x)-0.5)/n; ascending midranks; ties averaged; fixed common gene universe separately in each analysis
pairwise_effect: mean over source-called g and source-not-called h of I(-rho_g > -rho_h)+0.5*I(equal); 0.5 is a no-separation reference, not an experimental null distribution
generic_fragility: Fraction of all other finite R1 interactions for a gene with sensitive <= -1, excluding interactions involving PRKDC and excluding self; retain numerator and denominator

covariates: midrank fraction of source generic fragility
matched_control_diagnostic.distance: squared Euclidean distance in the three rank coordinates
matched_control_diagnostic.unmatched: retain in primary analysis, mark unavailable in matched diagnostic; no caliper expansion
matched_control_diagnostic.weighting: each matched source-called gene has total weight one, divided equally across its controls
matched_control_diagnostic.scope: Retrospective conditional diagnostic, not a prospectively available predictor or causal adjustment; gamma and rho share vehicle measurements

specificity_diagnostic.formula: q_DNAPKi_R2 - median(q_ATMi_R2,q_ATRi_R2,q_WEE1i_R2), with q based on -rho ranks
specificity_diagnostic.scope: Relative priority under the tested assay/dose conditions only; no equitoxic dosing claim and no biochemical or clinical selectivity claim

grid_role: Report all descriptive separation levels in both screens; no chosen minimum pharmaceutical value and no result-dependent headline threshold

uncertainty_policy.interpretation: Sensitivity of finite published scores, not repeated-screen uncertainty; aggregate tables do not identify assay replicate variance

sensitivities.name: complete400
sensitivities.warning: includes 20 genes with discordant R2 transcript labels; cannot independently rescue same-perturbation specificity

sensitivities.name: single_R3_record
sensitivities.cohort: subset of primary380 with exactly one original eligible-context R3 element record AND that record is paired-complete
sensitivities.warning: record count is determined before outcome interpretation; report actual N and source-positive count

sensitivities.name: no_missing_R3_records
sensitivities.cohort: subset of primary380 in which every original eligible-context R3 element record is paired-complete
sensitivities.warning: tests partial-record ascertainment; no substitution of missing values

continuous_source_scores: Display/source-order descriptive checks only; do not tune a source threshold
next_investment_policy: Stop after the first locked evidence report. The PI reviews magnitude, support and alternative explanations. No automatic modeling, target expansion, new dataset or wet-lab claim.
figures: F2 separate R2/R3 source-set separation with observed-record and gene-deletion sensitivity
F3 common-universe rank contrasts and matched-control diagnostic
required_runtime_binding: Map Stage0 schema/metadata to canonical fields using recorded semantics, save bindings and whitelist hashes BEFORE cross-source statistics. A unique mechanical mapping is permitted; semantic ambiguity requires STOP.
